snippet.title: Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered Latest Trailer
snippet.description:
【A fully-voiced, gritty hardboiled visual novel paying homage to classic Hong Kong cinema, now available in a remastered version!】
●Googleplay
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.rpgdl.wasp.redspider_remastered
●App Store
https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/6751768565

Set in Hong Kong in 2014, this hard-boiled visual novel tells the story of a former hitwoman whose husband, the leader of a criminal organization, is brutally attacked. To avenge him, she teams up with trusted allies to confront the ruthless perpetrators. It's a gripping experience filled with deep love and homage to classic Hong Kong noir films.

This is a remastered version of "Red Spider:Vengeance" a full-voice Hong Kong noir visual novel game originally released in 2014.

The scenario for this game was written with specific actual Hong Kong movie actors in mind, imagining them in these roles. Details on which actors inspired which characters are included in the game's "Cyclopedia."
The theme song is composed by Yasunori Shiono, known for his work on the SFC "Estpolis Denki" (Lufia) series.

A total of 19 cast members participated, with a total voice recording time of 4.1 hours.
The game has been changed from a standing image format to a still image format, with a total of over 530 still images.

Official Website:https://www.rpgdl.org/rslr/en.html
